meta.title: Corona Cabins | Carichí, Chihuahua
meta.description: Three family cabins in Carichí, Chihuahua, 43 minutes from the Bacabureachi hot springs. Slow down where the mountains, silence, and stars still set the pace.

hero.title: Corona Cabins
hero.subtitle: Slow down where the mountains, silence, and stars still set the pace.
hero.location: 43 minutes from the Bacabureachi hot springs

experience.heading: Everything you need to slow down
experience.body: Grills, a children’s area, private parking, and dark nights beneath the Chihuahua sky.

Cabaña Grande.name: Large Cabin
Cabaña Grande.desc: Two floors, generous spaces, and room to bring everyone together.
Cabaña Grande.details: Ideal for larger groups. Includes a kitchen, bathroom, terrace, and wood-burning stove.

Cabaña Mediana.name: Medium Cabin
Cabaña Mediana.desc: A practical stay for small families or groups of friends.
Cabaña Mediana.details: A balanced option for small families or friend groups.

Cabaña Pequeña.name: Small Cabin
Cabaña Pequeña.desc: Two floors, a terrace, and just enough space to disconnect.
Cabaña Pequeña.details: The most intimate option, ideal for a couple or a quiet stay.

booking.heading: Check dates for one cabin or several
booking.intro: Choose every cabin your group needs. We check them together and tell you exactly which cabin conflicts, so you can adjust the request before sending it.
booking.timesAndBuffer: Check-in is 1:00 PM and check-out is 12:00 PM. Availability also protects at least 8 hours between stays for cleaning.
booking.available: All selected cabins are available for these dates. Add your details and submit the request.
